claims.summary: In the charged character quotient for an edge-connectivity-at-least-four graph in its proper degree window, projection of multiplication by the binary sums of label-zero and label-one indicators onto Q1 has commutator rank 2m for even edge count m and 2m-2 for odd m, in dimension 2m+1, over F2 and F4.
claims.assessment: Working all-parameter direct basis calculation, with binary descent. Applies to the coordinate projection Q2 to Q1, not arbitrary projections or cutoffs; no obstruction to optimized proof-error ranks is asserted.
claims.rationale: Route-specific obstruction to treating degree compression as an automatically almost commuting representation. Does not advance the Frege lower bound or supply a new lower-bound family.

claims.summary: For Razborov's nonvacuous ell-generic disjoint d-set families with M>n>=1, 0<=ell<=m and 1<=d<=m, the Theorem 4.5 certified cutoff B=min(ell+1,d/2)(n-1)+d satisfies B/(mn)<=1/3+1/(3m)+1/n. Thus that certificate stays at most 1/3+o(1) as n grows.
claims.assessment: Working numerical consequence of the published definition and cutoff: d+ell<=m and 3 min(ell+1,d/2)<=m+1. Bounds the theorem's certificate, not actual PC hardness from above.
claims.rationale: Elementary source calibration for the ambient-midpoint lead; no novelty claim and no rejection of other families or stronger degree lower bounds.

claims.summary: In a Boolean function algebra over any field, a nonzero w satisfying x_i w=w for q distinct coordinates has unique multilinear representative (product_i x_i)v in the other coordinates, and degree q+deg v>=q.
claims.assessment: Working elementary support and multilinear uniqueness argument. This is the full Boolean algebra, not a charged pseudoideal; it tests denominator-supported weights only.
claims.rationale: Standard algebraic control recorded to prevent importing division elimination for identities into arbitrary ideal-membership proofs without accounting for denominators.

claims.summary: For every m>=1 over F4, eliminating one binary hidden variable of weights (1+omega,omega) from product_i(1+z x_i) yields 1+omega(product_i(1+x_i)-1), of exact multilinear old degree m, despite quadratic factors and a star factor graph.
claims.assessment: Working explicit all-m countercontrol; algebraic weights sum to one but are not probabilities. Efficient exact marginalization does not itself bound polynomial degree.
claims.rationale: Elementary degree-cost control for the signal-processing bridge, not a lower bound on contraction complexity or a rejection of all message interfaces.

claims.summary: Every beta in F_p((t)) satisfying beta^p-beta=0 lies in F_p; thus no nonconstant Laurent-series deformation preserves a legal prime-field scalar coefficient domain.
claims.assessment: Working elementary factorization into all p distinct linear factors, using that the Laurent-series ring here is a field. Does not prohibit valuation methods external to the coefficient assignment.
claims.rationale: Standard field fact recorded as a scope guard for tropical coefficient perturbations; no novel theorem or main-goal progress claimed.

relationships: Uses the exact proper degree window and local Fourier relations for arbitrary charges.
Identifies degree-one coordinates and separates distinct-edge quadratic products using the extra edge-connectivity assumption.
The coordinate projection is involution-stable, so the operators and commutator ranks descend to F2.
